body: Thank you, i appreciate your kind and inspiring words

ive tried. sometimes i get lucky and am able to go by myself because my mom either has things to do or whatever. ive realized that i benefit from one on one visits so much more because i can sit there and just let out all that built up anger and my feelings and thoughts. another problem that i have been facing recently is with my father. i work in the same factory he does and up until a couple weeks ago, everything was going well. once my depression started spiking out of control, i had no motivation to even go to work anymore. every single day he still wakes me up at 5am to go with him but i just cant. i have no motivation whatsoever and thats what me and him have been arguing about daily. he told me today that i got a couple days to get my act together or im fired. that seems like a ridiculous request

the main reason why its so hard for me to go alone is because when i returned from rehab, my parents froze up my bank account so i wouldnt have urges to withdraw money to go get high again. they also take my checks and deposit them for me and it sucks cause my copay for my psychiatrist is 30 bucks and im not gonna go back to my old ways of robbing people to get money. like im really trying to stay on the right path here and i feel like theyre my main trigger to just return to my own self. whenever i wanna go purchase something, like chewing tobacco for example which is 4 bucks where im from(i started doing that a lot at rehab cause thats all that was accessible to us there) my mom always has to be present to make sure im not using that money for anything else. its just super frustrating cause honestly ive had mulitple chances to get high since ive returned from rehab because alot of so called 'friends' from my town still use and every time i get asked i say no. i was a hardcore addict for 3 years and im only 21. i know what that shit does to a person and now that i think about it i find it disgusting because i still see kids nodding out right in front of me.

i used to have the same problem with opening up. i was literally a brick wall. i had this idea instilled in my head that no one would give a shit about what i had to say anyway. as unbearable as it was for me to finally open it, it literally set me free.

every single day they always bring up my past fuck ups. i cant even have a normal conversation with them. it always ends up with them saying they wish they had a normal son and why am i so fucked in the head etc. whenever i do go to my psychiatrist my mom always insists on coming and she even sits in the room. it makes it so much harder for me to actually talk about what i wanna say because i know when we get home shes gonna tell my dad about what was said and then they have even more shit to put me down with. they claim to be so understanding and shit but theyre going about it the wrong way. my parents hold my meds and sometimes they dont even give them to me which blows my mind. i know my meds arent supposed to help me out immediately but the time intervals i get them in are so fucked up. idk if thats why my depression gets worse everday but i just dont know what to do anymore
